toolbox.title: Teacher AI toolbox
toolbox.description: Add your material, create a draft, and make it your own.
toolbox.sourceHint: 10–16,000 characters · Import text from TXT/MD files. For PDFs, copy and paste the sections you need.
toolbox.pendingHint: Reading and organizing your material. Please give it a moment.
toolbox.generated: Your draft is ready. Review it and make any changes you need.
toolbox.staleResult: Your input changed. This is the previous draft. Create a new draft to use the changes.

toolbox.emptyTitle: A little help is on its way
toolbox.emptyDescription: Add your material and select Create a draft. Your result will appear here.

resource.title: Prepare from a resource
resource.description: Create summary cards and quiz drafts.
resource.placeholder:
Paste the material for your lesson.
For example: an explanation of the water cycle, a reading passage, or a relevant textbook section.

adapt.title: Explain it differently
adapt.placeholder:
Paste the content you want to simplify or adapt.
Add a grade or learning level to help tailor the explanation.

feedback.title: Rubrics and feedback
feedback.description: Start from criteria and student work.
feedback.placeholder:
Include the task, assessment criteria, and student answer.
For example: check whether the argument is supported, then suggest one next step.

notice.title: Write a family notice
notice.description: Turn dates and materials into a notice.
notice.placeholder:
Add the dates, materials, and information to share.
For example: field trip on October 20, departure at 9 a.m., bring water and a hat.

conference.title: Prepare for a conference
conference.description: Turn learning notes into a draft.
conference.placeholder:
Add learning observations, strengths, and points to discuss.
The draft will focus on facts in your notes.

notes.title: Organize notes
notes.placeholder:
Paste your observation records or meeting notes.
Organize facts, decisions, next steps, and details to confirm.
